result: If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy the default human response—so that before acting, people genuinely felt what others feel. Most conflict, injustice, and suffering stem from a failure to see each other’s humanity. If empathy guided decisions, compassion would replace cruelty, and many problems would begin to solve themselves.
